name: Ioanna Stavroula Mavraki
bio: Ioanna is an MSc student in Environmental Science (Chemistry, Toxicology and Health) working on whether the cultivated red alga Pyropia yezoensis (nori) accumulates the PFAS compound PFOA, where it localises in tissue, and whether toxicity is mediated by damage to its microbial community. She is characterising the nori-associated microbiome by Oxford Nanopore sequencing, alongside cultivation and fluorescence microscopy to localise microbes.
